metadata.description: The SkillCDN pack as plugins: skills for an AI agent to do real company work, one plugin per area of work. The same folders are served live through SkillCDN at skillcdn.ai/gh/skillcdn/skills.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Marketing and growth: ads, ad and product research, promotional video, content, campaigns, social posts. A short-form AI ad from a reference video and a product link, research in the Meta Ad Library for ad creatives and for rising products, and card news in a reference account's format: the account's format measured into a spec, a sourced topic brief with credited images from where the articles point, and the carousel built from both in the account's own slide types as HTML rendered to PNG.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Original video and audio content: scripted short dramas, series episodes and story-driven shorts. One episode of a vertical short drama on Higgsfield from a premise or a series bible, with native dialogue, verified lines and coded subtitles.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Software development and the tooling an agent works with: code, a codebase's documents, apps, testing, debugging. A skill written from work already done with an agent and a skill verified again from a fresh session; documents turned into a pack an agent searches through SkillCDN, and research in such a pack; a new web app built and put live on Cloudflare; payments with Stripe from a sandbox to live money; Meta ads from the pixel to running campaigns; the operator's dashboard as a separate Worker behind Cloudflare Access.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design work in the team's design tool: slides and decks, brand assets, icons and store graphics. A document moved into an existing Figma Slides deck as new slides in the deck's own measured design system, audited by numbers and zoomed renders; and a first-draft deck as HTML and PDF from an outline, in the organization's own tokens, before any design tool.
